styleDescription: Indie pop with a clean, modern production style. The arrangement features a bright acoustic guitar strumming syncopated rhythms, a tight electric bass with a rounded tone, and a drum kit with a crisp snare and punchy kick. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with occasional palm-muted lines. Male vocals are delivered in a conversational, rhythmic tenor, shifting into a layered, harmonized chorus. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of G major. The production uses subtle vocal doubling and light plate reverb on the lead vocal. The bridge features a stripped-back arrangement with staccato acoustic guitar before building back into a full-band finale.
